# ProxyWoman

> Free, open-source (Apache-2.0) native macOS HTTP/HTTPS debugging proxy, written in Swift. A free alternative to Proxyman, Charles Proxy and Fiddler. 免费开源的 macOS 原生抓包工具。

- Platform: macOS 14 or later, Apple silicon and Intel. No account, no telemetry, no paid tier.
- Capture and decrypt HTTPS, HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and WebSocket; per-app and per-host grouping.
- Rules with conditions and actions: rewrite headers, bodies, URLs and status codes; Map Local, Map Remote, mock responses, delays, blocking.
- Breakpoints, Compose and repeat, Copy as cURL, HAR export and import (opens HAR from Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Charles, Proxyman).
- JWT decoding; iPhone and Android capture with a QR code and http://proxywoman.cert; one-click certificate install into the iOS Simulator.
- Safe system proxy switch with automatic restore; chains to an existing proxy such as Clash.
- Built-in MCP server so AI assistants (Claude, Cursor) can read captured traffic, with redaction.
- English and Simplified Chinese UI.
